latestVersion.changelog:
YouTube Transcript Extractor API Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Allows users to extract YouTube video transcripts and metadata via the BrowserAct API using a simple script call.
- Supports extraction of video title, URL, publisher, channel link, likes count, and full transcript.
- Offers built-in error handling, including API Key validation and one automatic retry on failure.
- Provides clear setup and usage guidance for both users and agents.
- Requires users to supply their BrowserAct API Key before use.
